notes: Debris: Math.random = mulberry32(seed); spinAxes re-drawn from it first (3 per chip); per frame the actions run in order (hits -> spawnFromHits, scrapes -> spawnGroundScrapes, debug -> spawnDebugBurst, rebase -> FrameShift(rotation xyzw, offset)), then update(dt). Matrices are Matrix4.compose(position, quaternion, scale) of all 48 meshes per pool as float32, FNV-1a hashed; masks are visible flags. Marks: the moving surface velocity is deckVelocity for the frame and contains() answers the action's onDeck; per frame actions then update(dt); pools report the InstancedMesh count / visible, ring next, growing / movers counters, hashes over the whole instanceMatrix and ditherLevel arrays, dumps of the first 24 instances. exp: [x, Math.exp(x)].
